title: finding(skills): the objectstack-upgrade skill's "v17-canonical shapes, compiled" block authors a `select` with no options, which `FieldSchema` refuses once PR #21390 lands
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect, class (c)**, a teaching error in published text an AI author reads. `reach:` measured once at the public parse door: `ObjectSchema.safeParse` on the block, against the spec built from PR #21390's head, answers `success: false` with a `custom` issue at `fields.status.options`. `skills/**` ships with `npx skills add`; `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` priority rule 4: 「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_01YDt3PzwfrkuFzUBF89WPmM`, seat post #18549), from the #20827 dev report `5950037486` (out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Who acts on it:** the `skills/**` lane. It is a Tier H surface, so it lands by human approval in its own PR, ideally together with PR #21390. Neither publishes on merge: the release is the Version Packages PR, and the two should ship in the same release.

**Dedupe:** the 1,000 most recently updated issues and PRs here, open and closed (down to #2714), were listed by REST and grepped for `examples-upgrade`, and for `objectstack-upgrade` with `select`. That gave 3 hits: PR #21390 (the source, which names this in its Acceptance notes), and the closed PRs #20938 and #20691 (other subjects). As a control, `objectstack-upgrade` hits 5.

## The position (read at `main` `11905a4f8b`)

`skills/objectstack-upgrade/references/examples-upgrade.md:105`, inside the `<!-- os:check -->` block "The v17-canonical shapes, compiled":

```typescript
status: { type: 'select', required: true, storage: { notNull: true } },
```

- **The block claims more than it checks.** Its lead says it "is type-checked against the published spec, so it cannot rot into teaching a shape that no longer compiles". The type check passes, so `check:skill-examples` stays green. But PR #21390 (ruling A on #20827, `5910124148`) makes `FieldSchema` refuse at parse a `select` / `radio` with neither a non-empty `options` nor a `picklist`. The gate that would catch it is a parse, and nothing runs one on this block.
- **No other skill example authors an optionless choice field.** Grep over `skills/**` at `main` for `type: 'select'`, `type: 'radio'` and `Field.select({`: the other hits (`objectstack-data/SKILL.md:200`, `references/examples-objects.md:73` / `:80`, `rules/field-types.md:198`, `objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md:23`) all carry `options`.

## The fix

One `options` entry on `status` in that block, e.g. `options: [{ label: 'New', value: 'new' }, { label: 'Qualified', value: 'qualified' }]`. Nothing else in the block changes.
